series: George Nkencho shooting protest / Blanchardstown Garda Station
summary: The Dec31 report says participants committed to continue for 14 days into January; actual follow-up gatherings and whether they constitute separate event-month observations remain unsearched/unverified.

Dec15 is described as the 250th day of a picket series after April liquidation; Nov17 Dáil protests demanded government intervention. Dec15 Q102 source describes the immediate private retailer dispute and does not show a state-targeted demand at that location/date.
